barRaise.topFinding: Last run flagged that the dashboard audit block did not advance for BR when it advanced for Chains and Apothecary. This run found why, and the answer is structural rather than a missed write. BR's audit block is only ever written by scripts/write-dashboard-status.ps1, which runs from the release path. The YaE git history for status/data/Rising.json shows the last non-bar-raise write was 4144ce0 at the v0.59.49 release on 2026-07-25T15:12, and there has been no release since. Meanwhile audit-rising-nightly fired on 07-26 and again on 07-27, so the block is now two audits stale and still names docs/CANONICAL_AUDIT-2026-07-25.md, a file the retention policy deleted two days ago, with findings 0/0/0 on a window where the audits found three HIGH items. Chains.json and Apothecary.json both advanced this morning because their audit tasks write their own status JSON; BR's does not. The same wiring freezes workQueueDepth at 30 against 41 live BR queue items and itemsLeft.open at 34. This is not a flaky write, it is the block being hung off the wrong trigger, and a project that ships in bursts will show a stale audit row for every quiet day. Everything the audit chain itself owns worked: today's run produced docs/CANONICAL_AUDIT-2026-07-27.md, the drift pass applied 8 GDD edits, both committed as caa50ef, and six new items reached the queue. Health is flat at 83. Both hard rules pass, no BLOCK.
